items.item_text: Maintain District standards of excellent customer service and professional behavior in various and sometimes challenging situations.
Access and monitor District email daily to receive important updates from school and District administration.
Participate in staff development and in-service training programs as assigned.
Tutor individual or small groups of students, reinforcing instruction as directed by the teacher; monitor exercises, rehearsals and performances.

Provide training to students and assist teachers concerning the operation of musical instruments, fine arts methods, mediums, equipment, supplies and applications; explain related practices, procedures, and techniques; answer questions, resolve issues and perform demonstrations.
Engage students to create, learn and appreciate the arts by using a variety of modalities and media to encourage a fun, creative, learning environment.
Observe and control student behavior during class and individual group sessions; report progress regarding student performance and behavior.
Assist in the coordination and participate in student group activities related to visual and performing arts/music education and rehearsals.
Assist in the distribution, inventory, evaluation, repair or replacement of instruments or supplies.
Perform clerical tasks including duplicating materials, filing, typing and maintaining assigned records.
Communicate with teachers and parents regarding student progress, behavior or related matters.
Set up and take down equipment; communicate with appropriate personnel regarding equipment problems or damage.
Assist students with adjusting or repairing instruments and proper use of various art mediums or tools; respond to questions from students as needed.
Assure health and safety of students by following Districtpractices and procedures.
